ghas_title: 6 new alerts including 5 high severity security vulnerabilities

alerts.rule: Clear text storage of sensitive information
alerts.reason: Nest JWT access token is intentionally stored in HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie. This is the session authority surface (ADR-006). Not a clear-text log or DB store of raw secrets. Founder GHAS dismissal required — no protected-scope inline suppression.

alerts.rule: Clear text storage of sensitive information
alerts.reason: Admin double-submit CSRF cookie must be JS-readable (httpOnly=false). Session cookie remains HttpOnly. CSRF value is compared via timingSafeEqual to header — not a session secret. Founder GHAS dismissal required — no protected-scope inline suppression.
Static source-text host check replaced with URL hostname equality via sourceDeclaresHost().
Verifier failure path now strips CR/LF/U+2028/U+2029 before console.error.

note: Do not reintroduce Nest inline CodeQL suppressions — prior attempt caused PROTECTED_SCOPE_DRIFT=2 and invalidated Engine acceptance.
